paragraphs: Rav Acha Salla the great, grandfather of Rav Acha Salla, said in Abaye’s name. Perhaps he is Rabbi Chiyya the great’s grandfather. I did not find mention of the name; it also appears an error: if he is Rabbi Chiyya the great’s grandfather, how could he say in Abaye’s name? (See Abba bar Acha Salla.)
